messages:
Ravi K.: flagging a new partner ask 1: AWS UAE (me-south-1) marketplace + AMD MI300 dedicated offering. SI Asteria wants a joint listing + reserved capacity. need quota numbers, compliance checklist, and a channel pricing plan.
Omar G. (AWS): AWS partner ops: we can onboard marketplace listing but will need instance family details and expected vCPUs/GPU counts. also confirm whether this is Marketplace SaaS or AMI/Bring-Your-Subnet model.
Lina S.: sales ask: early public sector pilot (3 agencies) may request data residency in UAE. legal/compliance must confirm. Also want a EDU discount SKU for pilots.
Priya M.: legal touchpoint: UAE-specific DPA addendum + export control review for MI300. Do we have an existing export waiver from AMD? If not, will take time.
AMD-partner-bot: Quick note: MI300 availability in ME region limited this quarter. Partner discount requires engagement letter + forecast commit.
Ravi K.: expected start: soft-launch in 6 weeks. initial capacity: 6 dedicated MI300 nodes, burst to 12. target throughput: 180 req/s at 8k tokens with 4x batching.
DevInfra-bot: please include terraform module name for infra provisioning.
Ravi K.: terraform snippet below for infra team: 
```
module "aws-marketplace-me-south" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/modules/aws/marketplace.git//region"
  region = "me-south-1"
  instance_type = "p4d.mi300"
  dedicated_count = 6
  marketplace_mode = "ami"
}
```
Omar G. (AWS): For quota request to AWS marketplace, send estimated OnDemand vCPU and ENI counts. I can escalate capacity hold for the launch window if we lock dates.
Lina S.: pricing: propose two SKUs: "Redwood Inference - Dedicated (ME)" and "Redwood Inference - Hosted (Global)". Will map currency later; for now USD MSRP.
Asteria-SI: SI integration note: we need an onboarding playbook for agency customers (VPN, FedRAMP-like controls, audit logs). We can reuse EU playbook but will need region-specific ops steps.
Priya M.: timeline: I can draft UAE DPA addendum + export checklist by Wed EOD if AMD confirms waiver status. Also need clarity on log egress — is telemetry staying in region?
Ravi K.: telemetry will be optional region-local; default tenant data stays in ME region. we'll document telemetry options in marketplace listing.
AMD-partner-bot: Engagement letter template sent to Ravi. Expect 3-5 business days for partner pricing approval.
DevInfra-bot: infra action: create VPC peering diagram, egress estimate (TB/mo), and IAM role for marketplace connector. Drop estimates here after morning.
Ravi K.: action list: (1) Omar 1 finalize marketplace model & quota process (due 48h). (2) DevInfra 1 VPC/egress/IAM numbers (24h). (3) Priya 1 UAE DPA & export draft (Wed EOD). (4) Lina 1 SKU pricing sheet (EOD). (5) Asteria 1 onboarding template (Fri). (6) AMD 1 confirm waiver & discount timeline.
Lina S.: I'm going to spin the USD MSRP sheet and include an EDU/pilot row. Posting before Tue standup.
Omar G. (AWS): I'll open a capacity support case and provide the case number here once created. Need final committed nodes and go-live date.
Asteria-SI: propose partner sync Thu 10:00 GST to walk through runbook and compliance checklist.
Priya M.: Thu 10:00 works.
Ravi K.: thanks everyone 1 tagging @here for urgency :uae: :rocket: will share calendar invite and attach terraform + pricing draft. please drop any blocking items asap.
file_notes: Onboarding conversation for AWS UAE (me-south-1) marketplace + AMD MI300 dedicated capacity; includes terraform snippet, action items, and compliance flags
